```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)  
library(lme4)      
library(lmerTest)  
library(emmeans)     
library(patchwork)  
library(ggpattern)
```

```{r settings, results = "hide", message=FALSE, warnings = FALSE}
alphaThreshold <- 0.05  
suffix = "" #_peakcorrected"
cols_angle <- c("40" = "#f0b070", "90" = "#3f7fc4")
```

```{r eq_test}
me_eq_test <- function(b, se, df, sesoi, alpha = .05) {
  ci90 <- b + c(-1, 1) * qt(1 - alpha,     df) * se
  ci95 <- b + c(-1, 1) * qt(1 - alpha / 2, df) * se
  p_nhst    <- 2 * pt(-abs(b / se), df)
  p_equiv   <- max(pt((b + sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
                   pt((b - sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = TRUE))
  p_min_neg <- pt((b + sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = TRUE)    # b < -SESOI
  p_min_pos <- pt((b - sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = FALSE)   # b > +SESOI
  data.frame(estimate = b, se = se, ci90_low = ci90[1], ci90_high = ci90[2],
             ci95_low = ci95[1], ci95_high = ci95[2], sesoi = sesoi,
             p_nhst = p_nhst, p_equivalence = p_equiv,
             p_min_effect_neg = p_min_neg, p_min_effect_pos = p_min_pos)
}
```

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
# table exported from the MATLAB pipeline:
T <- read_csv(
  paste0("P:/Sein_Jeung/Project_Fold_Rotation/Results/grand_table", suffix, ".csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject           = col_character(),
    Trial             = col_double(),
    FoldingDifficulty = col_double(),
    FoldingAngle      = col_double(),
    ParietalNegativity = col_double(),
    latency           = col_double()
  )
)


T2 <- T %>%
  mutate(
    Subject           = factor(Subject),
    FoldingDifficulty = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(0, 4, 6)),
    FoldingAngle      = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(0, 40, 90))
  )


T <- T %>%
  mutate(
    Subject           = factor(Subject),
    FoldingDifficulty = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6)),
    FoldingAngle      = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90))
  )


contrasts(T$FoldingDifficulty) <- contr.treatment(2)
contrasts(T$FoldingAngle)      <- contr.treatment(2)


# drop rows with missing values
T_erp <- T %>% filter(!is.na(ParietalNegativity))
T_rt  <- T %>% filter(!is.na(latency))

#### for Helmert contrast


helmert_matrix <- matrix(
  c(-2/3, 1/3, 1/3,
     0,   1/2, -1/2),
  nrow = 3, ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(c("0", "4", "6"), c("BaselineVsFolding", "FourVSix"))  
)

# drop rows with missing values
T2_erp <- T2 %>% filter(!is.na(ParietalNegativity))
contrasts(T2_erp$FoldingDifficulty) <- helmert_matrix
####


```

```{r erp-model}
## ERP MODEL ##
erp_model <- lmer(
  ParietalNegativity ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle + (1 | Subject),
  data = T_erp,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(erp_model)
anova(erp_model)

cf <- summary(erp_model)$coefficients
erp_res <- me_eq_test(cf["FoldingAngle2", "Estimate"],
                      cf["FoldingAngle2", "Std. Error"],
                      cf["FoldingAngle2", "df"],
                      sesoi = 0.3)

erp_res
```

```{r rt-model}
## RT MODEL ##
rt_model <- glmer(latency ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle + (1|Subject), data = T_erp, family = Gamma(link = "log"))


summary(rt_model)
anova(rt_model)
```


```{r erp-cell-means}
erp_emm <- emmeans(erp_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle)
dfERP <- as.data.frame(erp_emm) %>%
  rename(ERP_fix = emmean) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90)),
    Folding  = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6))
  )

dfERP
```

```{r minimum effect test for RT}
sesoi_rt <- 1   #

# back-transform to seconds, then average over difficulty
emm_resp  <- regrid(emmeans(rt_model, ~ FoldingAngle * FoldingDifficulty))
emm_angle <- emmeans(emm_resp, ~ FoldingAngle)
con_avg   <- summary(contrast(emm_angle, method = "revpairwise"))   # 90° - 40°

rt_res <- me_eq_test(con_avg$estimate, con_avg$SE, df = Inf, sesoi = sesoi_rt)
print(rt_res, digits = 4)

# angle effect within each difficulty level (simple effects)
con_by <- summary(contrast(emm_resp, method = "revpairwise",
                           by = "FoldingDifficulty", simple = "FoldingAngle"))
rt_by  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(con_by)), function(i)
  cbind(FoldingDifficulty = con_by$FoldingDifficulty[i],
        me_eq_test(con_by$estimate[i], con_by$SE[i], df = Inf, sesoi = sesoi_rt))))
print(rt_by, digits = 4)
```

```{r plot-erp}
## plot the observed/estimated ERP effect ##
pERP <- ggplot(dfERP, aes(x = Rotation, y = ERP_fix, fill = Rotation, pattern = Folding)) +
geom_col_pattern(
position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
width = 0.6,
color = "black",
pattern_fill = "white",
pattern_colour = NA,
pattern_angle = 45,
pattern_density = 0.3,
pattern_spacing = 0.03
) +
#     geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
geom_errorbar(
aes(ymin = ERP_fix - SE, ymax = ERP_fix + SE),
position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
width = 0.2,
linewidth = 1
) +
scale_fill_manual(
values = cols_angle,
labels = c("40" = "40 degrees to fold", "90" = "90 degrees to fold")
) +
scale_pattern_manual(
values = c("none", "stripe"),
labels = c("4" = "4 faces carried", "6" = "6 faces carried")
) +
labs(x = "Folding Angle (\u00b0)", y = "Amplitude (\u00b5V)", fill = "Folding Condition") +
theme_classic() +
theme(
axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
#legend.position = c(0.95, 0.25),
#legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
#legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
#legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
#legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
#legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
text = element_text(size = 15),
legend.position = "none"
)
ggsave(
paste0("P:/Sein_Jeung/Project_Fold_Rotation/Figures/ERP", suffix, "_figure.png"),
plot = pERP,
width = 3.5,
height = 4,
units = "in",
dpi = 300
)

pERP
```

```{r rt-cell-means}
## ESTIMATED CELL MEANS FOR RT ##
rt_emm <- emmeans(rt_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle)
dfRT <- as.data.frame(rt_emm) %>%
  rename(RT_fix = emmean) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90)),
    Folding  = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6))
  )

dfRT
```

```{r plot-rt}

rt_emm <- emmeans(
  rt_model,
  ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle,
  type = "response"
)


dfRT <- as.data.frame(rt_emm) %>%
  rename(
    RT = response,
    SE = SE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Folding = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6)),
    Rotation = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90))
  )

dfRT

pRT <- ggplot(dfRT, aes(x = Rotation, y = RT, fill = Rotation, pattern = Folding)) +
geom_col_pattern(
position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
width = 0.6,
color = "black",
pattern_fill = "white",
pattern_colour = NA,
pattern_angle = 45,
pattern_density = 0.3,
pattern_spacing = 0.03
) +
geom_errorbar(
aes(ymin = RT - SE, ymax = RT + SE),
position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
width = 0.2,
linewidth = 1
) +
scale_fill_manual(
values = cols_angle,
labels = c("40" = "40 degrees to fold", "90" = "90 degrees to fold")
) +
scale_pattern_manual(
values = c("none", "stripe"),
labels = c("4" = "4 faces carried", "6" = "6 faces carried")
) +
labs(
x = "Folding angle (°)",
y = "Response time (s)",
fill = "Folding difficulty"
) +
theme_classic() +
theme(
axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
text = element_text(size = 15),
legend.position = "none"
)
ggsave(
"P:/Sein_Jeung/Project_Fold_Rotation/Figures/RT_figure.png",
plot = pRT,
width = 3.5,
height = 4,
units = "in",
dpi = 300
)
```

```{r Helmert contrast}

diff_model <- lmer(
  ParietalNegativity ~ FoldingDifficulty + (1 | Subject),
  data = T2_erp,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(diff_model)
anova(diff_model)

# Check direction of the effect with descriptive means
# (helps confirm folding conditions are MORE negative than baseline)
emmeans(diff_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty)
```
